$comment: REAL DATA, transcribed by hand from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFPO (AIP France, AMDT 11/26, chart dated 2026-10-01).
Only facts are recorded here; the charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed.
Runway geometry, taxiways, parking and frequencies also come from the simulator at run time; this file holds
what the simulator does not know: services, circuit rules and reporting points.
Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.

The French of "circuit", "withAts" and "withoutAts" is in "fr": same tree as the English, text values only, written by hand from the French column of the chart where it was read, and translated from the English text otherwise; point and runway identifiers are repeated unchanged.
name: Paris-Orly

source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text read by script for the notes; procedures written in French by hand

service.access: prior agreement from the Paris airports coordinator and PPR 72 working hours ahead; training flights banned; handling mandatory
service.equipment: APP and TWR frequencies and a mode A+C transponder are required

arrivals.instruction: contact Orly Tour 3 minutes before entering the Paris CTR; follow the route assigned by the tower between 1000 and 1300 ft AMSL

departures.instruction: contact Orly Prévol 10 minutes before start-up; follow the route assigned by the tower between 1000 and 1300 ft AMSL

withAts.specialVfr: with IFR traffic: visibility 3000 m, ceiling 900 ft, by day only
withAts.radioFailureOnArrival: if before the clearance to enter the aerodrome traffic zone, leave (or do not enter) the CTR by the inbound VFR route

notes: Jet aircraft are banned from the VFR 'aeroplane' routes.
Flying over the engine run-up area is prohibited when it is in use.
Hot spot: risk of runway intrusion via taxiway W5 if the pilot does not identify W1 turning north after LF.
Survol de l'aire d'essais moteurs interdit lorsque celleci est utilisée.

arrivals.instruction: contacter Orly Tour 3 minutes avant d'entrer dans la CTR Paris ; suivre l'itinéraire donné par la tour entre 1000 et 1300 ft AMSL

departures.instruction: contacter Orly Prévol 10 minutes avant la mise en route ; suivre l'itinéraire donné par la tour entre 1000 et 1300 ft AMSL

withAts.specialVfr: avec du trafic IFR : visibilité 3000 m, plafond 900 ft, de jour uniquement
withAts.radioFailureOnArrival: si la panne survient avant la clairance d'entrée dans la zone de circulation d'aérodrome, quitter (ou ne pas pénétrer dans) la CTR par l'itinéraire VFR d'arrivée
